controls.title: Every hashed structure is JCS-canonical first

controls.title: Egress enforcement is fail-closed
controls.claim: Egress is fail-closed: an empty or nil allowlist denies everything and an explicit deny beats an allow.

controls.title: Tenant and principal come from the token

Only the approval workload routes take tenant and workspace from a verified JWT, and CTL-006 binds the configured scope while the emergency-stop fence is on.
protected_operations: Tenant-scoped runtime routes.
bypass_assumptions: Any holder of the shared key may assert any registered tenant and principal pair.
